name: thegram-api
description: Connect Claude Code to Thegram with a scoped API key. Search, read and cite linked goals, decisions, requirements, evidence and sources in Thegram vaults and GramHub data, and save typed records only when you ask.

api_key.title: Thegram API key
api_key.description: A scoped key from Settings > Agents > API keys at https://vault.thegram.one/. Claude Code keeps it in your system credential store.
